mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/62aada1958ed-t1/ws/prep_4BE0; cat > /srv/leakruns/62aada1958ed-t1/ws/prep_4BE0/build_4BE0.py <<'EOF'
"""design_4BE0 준비 스크립트: TP 샘플 생성, 피처·결과 산출, family 단위 분할. 학습/성능 계산 없음."""
import json, sys
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"; OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
design = json.load(open(WS / "design_4BE0.json"))

p = pd.read_csv(D/"patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D/"admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time","discharge_time"])
l = pd.read_csv(D/"labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time","report_time"]).rename(columns={"unit":"lab_unit"})
a = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

# --- TP 샘플: 입원 후 offset 시점. 퇴원 이후 TP는 '입원 중 매일' 질문에 맞지 않아 제외(설계서 미명시, 가정)
rows = []
for off in design["tp"]["offsets_h"]:
    t = a[["admission_id","patient_id","family_id","admit_time","discharge_time","discharge_status","unit","age","sex"]].copy()
    t["offset_h"] = off; t["tp"] = t.admit_time + off*H
    rows.append(t)
s = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
s["in_hosp_at_tp"] = s.tp < s.discharge_time

def kdigo_flags(cr, tcol):
    """각 크레아티닌 측정에 대해 같은 입원 내 이전 측정 대비 KDIGO 충족 여부(48h +0.3 / 7일 최솟값×1.5)."""
    cr = cr.sort_values(["admission_id", tcol]); out = np.zeros(len(cr), bool)
    for _, g in cr.groupby("admission_id", sort=False):
        tt = g[tcol].values; v = g.value.values; idx = g.index
        for i in range(len(g)):
            prev48 = v[:i][tt[:i] >= tt[i] - np.timedelta64(48,"h")]
            prev7 = v[:i][tt[:i] >= tt[i] - np.timedelta64(168,"h")]
            f = (len(prev48) and v[i]-prev48.min() >= 0.3) or (len(prev7) and v[i] >= 1.5*prev7.min())
            out[i] = bool(f)
        cr.loc[idx, "_f"] = out[:len(g)] if False else None
    return cr

cr = l[l.test=="creatinine"].copy()

def aki_by(sample, tcol, lo, hi, ref_lo):
    """sample의 각 TP에 대해 [lo,hi) 구간에 tcol로 들어온 측정 중 KDIGO 충족이 있는지. 기준값은 ref_lo 이후 같은 입원 측정."""
    m = sample[["sid","admission_id","tp","admit_time"]].merge(cr[["admission_id","value",tcol]], on="admission_id")
    m = m[(m[tcol] >= ref_lo(m)) & (m[tcol] < hi(m))].sort_values(["sid", tcol])
    res = {}
    for sid, g in m.groupby("sid", sort=False):
        tt = g[tcol].values; v = g.value.values; L = lo(g).values; hit = False
        for i in range(len(g)):
            if tt[i] < L[i]: continue
            p48 = v[:i][tt[:i] >= tt[i]-np.timedelta64(48,"h")]
            p7 = v[:i][tt[:i] >= tt[i]-np.timedelta64(168,"h")]
            if (len(p48) and v[i]-p48.min() >= 0.3) or (len(p7) and v[i] >= 1.5*p7.min()):
                hit = True; break
        res[sid] = hit
    return sample.sid.map(res).fillna(False).astype(bool)

s["sid"] = np.arange(len(s))
# 제외: 입원~TP 사이 '보고된' 크레아티닌으로 이미 KDIGO AKI 확인
s["aki_known_by_tp"] = aki_by(s, "report_time", lambda m: m.admit_time, lambda m: m.tp, lambda m: m.admit_time)
# 결과: [tp, tp+48h) 채취 크레아티닌이 KDIGO 충족, 기준값은 tp-168h 이후(같은 입원)
s["aki_48h"] = aki_by(s, "collect_time", lambda m: m.tp, lambda m: m.tp+48*H, lambda m: np.maximum(m.tp-168*H, m.admit_time))

# 피처: report_time < tp 기준
for f in design["features"]:
    if f["source"] != "labs": continue
    lo = (lambda m: m.admit_time) if f["window"]["start"]=="admit" else (lambda m: m.tp-48*H)
    m = s[["sid","admission_id","tp","admit_time"]].merge(l[l.test.isin(f["filter"]["test"])][["admission_id","value","report_time"]], on="admission_id")
    m = m[(m.report_time >= lo(m)) & (m.report_time < m.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
    agg = {"min":"min","max":"max","last":"last","count":"size"}[f["agg"]]
    s[f["name"]] = s.sid.map(m.groupby("sid").value.agg(agg))
s["n_cr"] = s.n_cr.fillna(0).astype(int)

# 결과 확인 가능성(censoring): 결과창 안에 퇴원/사망, 결과창 내 크레아티닌 측정 수
s["discharged_in_window"] = s.discharge_time < s.tp + 48*H
cw = s[["sid","admission_id","tp"]].merge(cr[["admission_id","collect_time"]], on="admission_id")
cw = cw[(cw.collect_time >= cw.tp) & (cw.collect_time < cw.tp+48*H)]
s["n_cr_outcome_window"] = s.sid.map(cw.groupby("sid").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)

s["eligible"] = (s.age >= 18) & s.in_hosp_at_tp & ~s.aki_known_by_tp
c = s[s.eligible].copy()

# 분할: family_id 결측(가족 미등록)은 patient_id로 대체해야 같은 환자가 train/test에 갈리지 않음
c["split_group"] = c.family_id.fillna(c.patient_id)
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=design["split"]["test_fraction"], random_state=design["split"]["seed"])
tr, te = next(gss.split(c, groups=c.split_group))
c["split"] = "train"; c.iloc[te, c.columns.get_loc("split")] = "test"

feat = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
c[["sid","admission_id","patient_id","family_id","split_group","offset_h","tp","split"]+feat+
  ["aki_48h","discharged_in_window","discharge_status","n_cr_outcome_window"]].to_csv(OUT/"cohort_4BE0.csv.gz", index=False)
s.drop(columns=feat[:0]).to_csv(OUT/"all_tp_4BE0.csv.gz", index=False)
print("done", len(s), len(c))
EOF
cd /srv/leakruns/62aada1958ed-t1/ws/prep_4BE0 && time python3 build_4BE0.py
